title: The local geometry of the stack of $A_r$-stable curves
summary: In this paper we study the local geometry of the stack of pointed $A_r$-stable curves. In particular, we analyze the deformation theory of $A_r$-stable curves and their automorphism groups in order to study the combinatorics of families of curves over $[\mathbb{A}^1/\mathbb{G}_m]$, and use this to classify all closed points of the stack of $A_r$-stable curves. As a byproduct, we also classify all open substacks of the moduli stack of degree $2$ cyclic covers of $\mathbb{P}^1$ that admit a separated good moduli space.
